QuestInfo.name: [Snowdrift Lodge] Undercover Resort Cop
QuestInfo.0: Selina, the concierge at the Snowdrift Lodge, has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Selina, the concierge at the Snowdrift Lodge, has a request for you. Items are disappearing from guests' suites! It's time to go undercover and catch the thief!
QuestInfo.2: You helped Selina, the Snowdrift Lodge concierge, with her request.

1.0: Did you catch the thieves in the act? Surely they'll be back. If you encounter them, don't show any mercy! We've got to make an example of those wrongdoers. If you manage to retrieve the items they stole, please bring them to me.
